caption:
Toto spends hours at the skate park every weekend. Every landing jolts his knees, and his back is stiff afterwards.

Balance on a board comes from your trunk and hips as well as your feet. Landing with bent knees and hips can help spread the load.

Hybi's prep: 10 slow bridges, 30 seconds on one leg each side, and a few easy squats before you skate. Clinical Pilates can help build trunk and hip control.

Big swelling after a fall or a knee that gives way is worth an assessment first. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physio-led clinical Pilates team can help. Book online via the link in bio
